Untrusted text can try to alter model behavior. Keep data separate from trusted instructions,
constrain tool access, validate outputs and require approval for sensitive actions.
Website, document Jහහෝ user message එකකේ තුළ AI එකට Jවනතේ instruction එකකේ දීලා rules
මාරු කරන්න උතේසාහ කරන්න පුළුවන්. External checks වලින් actions control කරන්න.

A retrieved FAQ contains text asking the bot to reveal secrets; it must remain untrusted data.
